plain: Around 2004 in Iraq, possibly near Tikrit, an Al Jazeera news clip showed an invisible figure, a see-through blob with limbs, climbing up onto an American Abrams tank and down into the gunner's hatch. John Blitch, a former scientist at DARPA, the Pentagon's research agency, tells Michels he saw the footage himself, slowed down and played about three times, with first two limbs, then two more, then "this blob climbs up onto the tank." He names the newscaster Katie Couric in telling it and connects what he saw to invisibility, which would mean someone on that battlefield could make themselves almost impossible to see.
